# Dot Led

**Carry › Object-Led** · v1.0.0 · 48 frames at 30 fps (24–90)

A dot bounces across the old scene and lands, then the new scene grows out of it.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/dot-led@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Playful explainers
- Pointing at the next thing
- Kids content

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import dotLed from './transitions/08-carry/object-led/dot-led';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(dotLed, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 48 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | color | `"#FF4F1A"` |  | Colour of the leading element; use the incoming scene's background colour so it becomes the new background. |
| `size` | number | `0.06` | 0.02–0.2 | Dot size, as a share of frame height. |
| `toX` | number | `0.62` | 0–1 | Where the dot lands, x. |
| `toY` | number | `0.55` | 0–1 | Where the dot lands, y. |
